title: Algorithmic soup: evolution of composition and reuse
_why_closed_at_reconcile: The brief's first action asks whether the real organism can call, compose, re-invoke and address intermediates. It cannot: its only act is adding a 3-bit magnitude x 251 to one fixed world register per tick; it selects no operation and owns no workspace. Exposing a soup would require inventing a program representation with a private workspace, which the brief forbids. The one substrate-native composition form (the representation ecology's straight-line 'program' chain) was probed and cannot exceed its own primitive ceiling on held-out seeds.
seven_questions: answered from code in SUBSTRATE_RECONCILE.md with file:line citations

why_inconclusive_and_not_null: NULL would claim that composable access did not change evolutionary capability under a posed, powered comparison. No comparison was posed: the substrate has no composition mechanism to give or withhold, and the one chain form cannot clear a primitive ceiling that itself sits at the floor.
what_was_not_done_deliberately: No PREREGISTRATION.md: writing one for an instrument the substrate cannot supply would be a ritual.
No VM, no persistent workspace, no soup interface on top of the 3-bit action channel: the brief forbids inventing them and the probe shows the world would not reward them on held-out seeds.
e08 was not reopened or reinterpreted.
what_a_future_attempt_would_need: An organism that can select, invoke and chain operations over an addressable workspace it owns, with reuse expressible as one intermediate feeding two consumers.

A world screen in which capability generalises from training seeds to held-out seeds, so a primitive ceiling and an above-ceiling target both exist on the assay distribution (in w13 every probed program form sits at the floor on held64).
Both are new substrate work (organism family + world screen), not an interface; they belong to a substrate build round, not to a campaign experiment.
doctrine_promoted: A reconcile step that answers 'what can the organism actually do' from the code, plus one 30-second probe of the nearest native form, rejected a ten-predicate experiment before a line of preregistration was written. Cheap rejection of an unaskable world is the campaign's stated success criterion.
